Tenable Entity Top Liner Lock Folding Knife | 3.52“ Blackwash 14C28N Blade | Black G10 Handle | Nalu Knives Design - B1036H3

About Design

The Entity is a sturdy flipper knife built for everyday carry. Its upgraded Top Liner Lock provides secure blade lockup and reliable operation while maintaining smooth, effortless deployment. The blade features a wickedly sharp edge with a bold, wide profile, delivering excellent cutting performance. The ergonomically designed handle offers a secure, comfortable grip and a confident feel in hand, making the upgraded Entity a reliable choice for daily use.

About Designer

Nalu Boersma has been rapidly building a fanbase in a few short years as a maker to watch for good reason. Building them one at a time manually, produces a knife that has an old-world feel with new-world materials. His unique aesthetic blends with our design concept perfectly and his attention to detail makes the knife a joy to deploy and use.

Features

Wide-Profile 14C28N Blade
The Entity features a wide-profile 14C28N blade, offering excellent sharpness, corrosion resistance, and reliable cutting performance for everyday carry.

Smooth & Reliable Top Liner Lock
The upgraded Top Liner Lock provides secure blade lockup and reliable operation, while maintaining smooth one-handed opening and closing.

Durable G10 Handle Options
Available in Gray G10, Glow-in-the-Dark Green G10, Black G10, and Camouflage G10, the new G10 handle offers a secure grip, durability, and distinctive style.

Fast Flipper Deployment
The rear flipper tab and smooth bearing pivot deliver fast, crisp, and consistent blade deployment.
